title: JoJo Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: JoJo- Seaside, FL- renovated townhome with a prime location on Ruskin Park, multiple balconies and decks with outdoor dining and views! King primary with designer bathroom. Sleeps 7, just steps to Seaside Beach.
description_expanded: Description306 WEST RUSKIN PLACEKING, 2 TWINS, 1 DAYBED, QUEEN MURPHY BED (sleeps 7) Prime Ruskin Park Location in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaThoughtfully designed by an interior decorator owner, JoJo is a beautifully renovated Ruskin Park townhome that delivers style, comfort, and one of the most sought-after locations in Seaside, Florida. Ideally situated just behind Central Square, this gem overlooks Ruskin Park and offers charming park and town views from nearly every level. Guests enjoy a premier Seaside location only 352 yards (a 4-minute walk) to beach access and just two minutes to downtown Seaside, placing shops, dining, and entertainment right outside your door.Designer Interiors with Multiple Living SpacesThis two-bedroom, three-bath townhome has been artfully staged with luxury furnishings and curated design details throughout. Up the first set of stairs, vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light welcome you into the main living level. The home features two distinct living areas, ideal for gathering or spreading out. At the front of the townhome, the first sitting area includes a sofa, club chair, and mounted flat-screen TV. Adjacent is a stylish dining area with a round glass table seating six. The centrally located, updated kitchen features stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a large double-door refrigerator—perfectly equipped for preparing meals at home.Seamless Indoor–Outdoor LivingAt the rear of the home, the primary living room features two large sofas, a mounted flat-screen TV, and double French doors that flood the space with natural light. These doors open onto a spacious rear open-air deck with outdoor dining, creating an ideal setting for alfresco meals or evening wine. Tucked discreetly into a custom-built closet is a queen Murphy bed, allowing the space to comfortably accommodate additional guests. A full bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination is also located on this level.Private Bedroom Suites and Elevated Outdoor SpacesUp the second set of stairs, the third floor offers two beautifully appointed bedrooms and additional thoughtful sleeping space. The king primary suite features a mounted flat-screen TV, a renovated luxury en-suite bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and rain shower head, and French doors that open onto a private open-air deck—perfect for morning coffee overlooking the park. The second bedroom includes two twin beds, a large dresser, ample space, and its own mounted flat-screen TV. Nearby, a stunning designer bathroom features a single vanity, statement chandelier, and glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Between the bedrooms, a built-in twin bed beneath a skylight creates a cozy and memorable sleeping nook—especially loved by younger guests.A Stylish Seaside Retreat for Gathering and RelaxationWith multiple indoor and outdoor living areas, JoJo offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and flexibility for families and groups. Whether enjoying park views from the balcony, dining under the stars, or strolling into town for coffee and shopping, this townhome captures the essence of Seaside living. JoJo’s prime location and designer finishes make it a standout Seaside vacation rental that is sure to impress.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES2,730 square feetSeaside private residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion352 yards (4-minute walk) to beach access; access to the largest private beaches on 30ACovered private parking for two vehicles in a carport with private drivewayAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000076
